reviews.text:
Excellent quality.
The saleswoman is very kind and gives great advice.
The products are amazing.
Thank you to Ilona for her attention and valuable advice. She listened carefully to my dog's needs and my own. I highly recommend her!
A very nice shop, with lots of lovely things, a warm welcome, I recommend it!
Excellent advice and a warm welcome.
Excellent advice and a great range of products! The dog before us seemed delighted.

Excellent service! Always great with advice.
A wide variety of kibble and treats.
Great place to treat our canine friends! The staff are super friendly and incredibly helpful!
A fantastic team, always smiling. A wide selection of chews that my dog ​​loves! Thank you 💜 …
A fantastic, very welcoming establishment with a wide selection! We received excellent advice, especially in finding the right pajamas after our dog's surgery! I highly recommend it!
I recommend this new shop. Very pleasant welcome and, above all, excellent advice.
A fantastic shop and a warm welcome from Ilona. I received excellent advice and found only great products! Thank you!

We stopped by this morning to pick up a necklace and some cans of pâté. The ladies were absolutely lovely and gave us wonderful advice.
Thank you again ✨💕 …
A warm welcome and attentive listening. Perfect.
Top-notch products and service, thank you little dad ✨
Wonderful experience at Petit Père's! The welcome is always top-notch! Go for it!

Excellent shop, the products are great, high quality, and the staff are lovely!
My dad loves it every time he goes!
Fantastic shop! A wide selection of products, including a lovely variety for rabbits. I received a very warm welcome and excellent advice. The staff are lovely, friendly, and attentive!
Thank you, Doriane.
The welcome is always warm, and there's a great collection of chewable items. I recommend it.
My dog's favorite store! The toys and accessories are of excellent quality, the saleswomen are lovely and very helpful!
Excellent service

I knew of P'tit Père by name, but I hadn't actually been there! Living in Croix-Rousse, I'm thrilled that a shop has finally opened in the neighborhood ☺️
The team is lovely, always available, and offers great advice. My dog ​​has figured out that this is the new shop to delight her taste buds; she tries to take me there every day of the week!

I discovered P'tit Père at their other store in Lyon's 6th arrondissement, and I'd heard about the opening of this new location.

So happy to see the brand expanding to Lyon! The concept is really great, and the product selection is fantastic, with lots of original items and wonderful ideas to discover 🐈‍⬛🦮
Great shop, very well stocked and with excellent advice!
Great shop with good advice! ☺️
Great pet shop :) Good advice and a great atmosphere!

Always a warm welcome, friendly staff, and great advice.
Always a pleasure to come to Fripouille et Frimousse.

A really beautiful shop with lots of choices for dogs!

And the service was fantastic! I highly recommend it :)
Great shop and welcoming staff. I recommend it.
A lovely shop with a good selection, super cuddly toys, and excellent advice.

We started by ordering online, then became regulars at the shop in the 6th arrondissement and now at the one in the 4th! Lots of choice in mastiffs and equipment! Excellent service and advice for both humans and dogs!
Always well received
Friendly welcome, helpful and knowledgeable staff, products for both dogs and cats
Great place for them and for us, thank you for the welcome :)

A very warm welcome, excellent advice, and a beautiful shop!

I highly recommend it!

A very warm welcome in this lovely shop. So many choices and innovative products such as ice cream for dogs, ice cubes, smoothies, and lots of cute toys. A great selection for my cat too. I highly recommend it.
Great shop, lots of chewable options!
I received a warm welcome, there was a lot of choice, and I was able to find something to please my dog.
A very nice shop in a neighborhood that finally offers a quality place for our animals. I recommend it; you can also find good advice there. Thank you for your welcome!
Superb quality products and a lovely team who take the time to advise us and get to know our animals
Gringo, a Nova Scotia Duck Tolling Retriever, is thrilled to have found his favorite life jacket and loved the store experience!
Great shop, very varied and comprehensive selection!! Excellent advice, fantastic salespeople!!!
First visit to this shop, I received a very warm welcome and helpful advice for my cat. I will definitely go back!
Top-notch shop for dogs in Croix Rousse!
Thank you Gaëlle for the comment.

Super cute shop! So many (too many) choices 🤤🤤.
I came in for duck treats and left with loads of other delicious things 👀.

Thanks for the warm welcome. Cannelle will be back 🙃
Top
A dog lover's paradise! Fantastic welcome, amazing selection of chews! Excellent advice, highly recommended.
A great shop where you can find lots of items for both dogs and cats.
Go for it without hesitation.
Excellent welcome and advice at the Lyon 4 store, I highly recommend it for your four-legged companions!
A warm welcome, personalized and tailored advice.
Always good advice and a great selection for dogs and cats ☀️
They always take great care of my cat! Lots of varied choices!
A really great pet shop. Organic and high-quality products for my cat – it's perfect!!! 👍😻 …
A wide selection of quality treats, especially chew toys. Great advice too! I recommend them for your dogs.
The staff is amazing!! We felt welcomed, well advised, and pampered, both us and our dogs. Quality products with a great selection. Thank you!!!

As a regular customer of your first store, I decided to visit your second location, and everything is perfect there too. I found what I was looking for, despite the lack of air conditioning and internet connection, which makes longer visits more difficult, especially during this heatwave. The sales staff are always excellent, whatever the request.
